subject.title: fix: suppress exec-like tool error warnings regardless of includeDetails

question: Should exec-like tool failures with `includeDetails: true` be suppressed across full-verbose, cron, heartbeat, and mutating exec/bash paths, or should those existing visible-warning cases remain intentional?
rationale: Current tests and prior merged behavior intentionally surface some exec failures with details, while this PR asserts a broader suppress-all policy without changing the earlier mutating branch or updating the contract.

options.title: Clarify And Rework First
options.body: Confirm the desired warning contract, then rework the branch order and tests so the code matches that policy before merge.

options.title: Keep Existing Visible Detail Contract
options.body: Reject this suppress-all direction and narrow the linked issue to a smaller bug that does not undo cron, heartbeat, full-verbose, or mutating exec warnings.

options.title: Accept Broad Suppression
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally suppress all exec-like warnings with details, but should require explicit test updates and real behavior proof for the changed message surface.

recommendation.title: Clarify And Rework First
recommendation.body: Confirm the desired warning contract, then rework the branch order and tests so the code matches that policy before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest recent history on the payload and mutation surfaces plus prior review context for incomplete exec-like warning fixes.
